name: Holographic Client Lockdown
author: Holographic

sections.description:
Holographic Client Lockdown helps website designers, freelancers and agencies hand WordPress sites over to clients while keeping high-risk admin areas under control.

The plugin creates a Client Owner role, keeps normal administrators out of lockdown rules, and lets you add a custom support card to the WordPress dashboard for logged-in users. Client Admin Lockdown lets you choose which existing non-administrator roles are restricted, then control access to posts, pages, media, comments, Appearance, plugins, users, tools, settings, updates, the Customizer and Site Health.

It also includes developer update alert emails, optional login branding, WordPress toolbar logo replacement, a branded settings header logo, login colours and admin footer text.

Features

  • Restricted Client Owner role.
  • Role selection for Client Admin Lockdown.
  • Client Admin Lockdown controls for posts, pages, media, comments, Appearance, plugins, users, tools, settings, updates, the Customizer, Site Health and profile access.
  • Admin menu hiding for restricted roles.
  • Direct URL blocking for restricted admin pages.
  • Protection for search engine visibility, Site URL, Home URL and permalinks.
  • Dashboard support card for all logged-in users, including administrators.
  • Developer update alert emails for WordPress core, plugin and theme updates.
  • Optional support card page ID so admins can design support card content with the WordPress editor.
  • Optional login logo, login colours, WordPress toolbar logo, settings header logo and footer text for logged-in users.
  • Built-in HoloLock help page explaining each major setting.
  • Upgrade page showing the professional controls available in Holographic Client Lockdown Pro.
  • Optional cleanup on uninstall.
sections.faq:
Is this a security plugin?

It is a client access and admin lockdown plugin. Use it to reduce accidental client changes to high-risk WordPress areas. Keep using proper security hardening, updates, backups and account protection alongside it.

Does it affect administrators?

Administrators are not restricted from WordPress admin areas. The dashboard support card and branding settings do apply to administrators so they can see the client-facing experience they are configuring.

Can clients still edit pages?

Yes. The default Client Owner role can edit pages and upload media unless you block those areas in Client Admin Lockdown. The support card can display content from a selected WordPress page.

Can I remove all plugin data?

Yes. Enable the uninstall cleanup option before deleting the plugin. The Client Owner role is removed only when no users still have that role.

What does the Pro version add?

Holographic Client Lockdown Pro adds page-level editing rules, a client permissions matrix, client admin menu control, full dashboard replacement, emergency controls, hidden technical notices for client users, activity logging and restricted-access alerts.
